tool.name: Get View
tool.description: Read the USE JSON document of a stored generative view.

ai.systemPromptSection:
### get_view
Read a stored view's USE document, e.g. before patching it with update_view.

**Format:**
```tool_request
{"tool":"get_view","query":"{\"id\":\"<uuid>\"}"}
```
whenToUse: User asks what a stored view contains
whenNotToUse: You already have the current document from this conversation
